data.name: OpenFileDescription
data.value: Select a file and open it with the appropriate editor.

data.name: OpenWorkspaceDescription
data.value: Browse recent workspaces and choose a project or solution to open.

data.name: OpenFolderDescription
data.value: Choose a folder as the workspace, keeping the existing save and cancellation prompts when switching.

data.name: SaveDescription
data.value: Save changes to the current document when its editor permits saving.

data.name: SaveAsDescription
data.value: Open Save As when the current editor supports it. The image editor exports the current rendered image.

data.name: CloseDocumentDescription
data.value: Close the current document tab, following the editor's confirmation flow for unsaved changes.
